description: Post a comment with explicit audience (Team only or Team and clients), optional teammate mentions and PNG/JPG/PDF files. Reuse requestId when retrying the same submission after a lost response.

attachments.description: Optional attachments; at most 10 MiB total. Server validates file bytes.

base64.description: Base64 file bytes, without a data URL prefix

content.description: Comment text; may be empty when attaching files

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

issueId.description: Issue UUID or display id such as OQ-12

mentionedUserIds.description: Teammate userIds from list_project_members. In content, use @[userId] for each mention.

requestId.description: New UUID for this comment. Reuse it only when retrying the same comment after an uncertain response, to avoid duplicates.

visibility.description: internal = Team only; public = Team and clients

name: create_comment
